# 2025 Modern Coding Standards

When generating or modifying code in this workspace, adhere to the following standards:

## Layout
- Strictly use Flexbox and CSS Grid for all layouts.
- Never use percentages (%) for layout widths.

## Responsive Design
- Always follow a "Mobile-First" approach.

## Selectors
- Use Classes for all styling.
- Do not use IDs for CSS.

## HTML
- Use semantic tags (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<nav>`) instead of generic `<div>`.

## JavaScript
- Use modern ES6+ syntax including arrow functions, destructuring, and template literals.

## Refactoring
- When asked to refactor, prioritize removing legacy 2010-era code.
